limitations: r41 gameplay NOT RUN; on gu-native the picture's place comes from its source (device.c backend_present), not from a run
r40 ran on Eden and MHGURecomp 0.14.3 with a player report of correct placement; Ryubing and Switch hardware were not run with r40
Ryubing: r38 and earlier stop the game with an undefined QADD/QSUB once monster HP bookkeeping runs; r39 ran there, unitemized
on MHGURecomp the Wilds text outline is missing, confirmed by the user: "damage number recomp note is true, i played it"; the mod's ini there has style = wilds, so the Rise effect rests on the source
r38 ran on Eden master-07677aa500-master with a player report for damage numbers; loading beside a foreign hook on the same entry has not been exercised and rests on Forge's hook.c and host fixtures
r36 has not been run. Kinsect, poison, blast and mount detection come from static research of MHGU 1.4.0 code without a gameplay trace.
The mount number is taken from the fixed HP subtraction in ride state 0xd; identifying it as the mount finisher is an inference from the surrounding ride code.
Poison, blast and mount numbers have no owner and appear for every player at the monster root position.
Show other damage cannot attribute its numbers. Online it may include other hunters' attacks, and damage landing at once can merge into one number.
r30 has not yet been run on the affected devices; if the native applied crop is unavailable or invalid, the mod retains Forge display bounds.
The existing camera-admission policy still cannot prove presentation ownership of a same-aspect offscreen camera.
Map-fired shells have no hunter owner; their numbers show for every player. Cannon, huge cannon and Dragonator projectiles were not traced.
Hits outside the camera view show only if the camera turns to them within the number's lifetime (0.4 to 2 seconds); there is no edge indicator.
